Paste a message, or share one from WhatsApp or any app to Linda. It never leaves your phone.
Linda cannot be sure. If it asks for money or your PIN, do not trust it.
Linda reads your incoming text messages on your phone and warns you before a scammer can trick you. Your messages are never sent anywhere.
Linda needs to see new text messages, show you warnings, and check whether a sender is in your contacts.
Open Settings, find Linda in Battery, and choose "Unrestricted" or "Don\'t optimise". Without this your phone may stop Linda when the screen is off.
Tecno: Settings > Apps > Linda > Battery > "No restrictions". Then open Phone Master or Phone Manager > Autostart and switch Linda on. Also lock Linda in the recent-apps list.
Infinix: Settings > Apps > Linda > Battery > "No restrictions". Then open XOS Phone Master > Autostart and switch Linda on. Also lock Linda in the recent-apps list.
Itel: Settings > Battery > Battery optimisation > Linda > "Don\'t optimise". Then open Phone Manager > Autostart and switch Linda on.
Samsung: Settings > Apps > Linda > Battery > "Unrestricted". Then Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > Never sleeping apps > add Linda.
Xiaomi, Redmi or Poco: Settings > Apps > Manage apps > Linda > Autostart on, and Battery saver > "No restrictions". Also lock Linda in the recent-apps list.

If Linda is sure a message is a scam, it can tell the Linda radar so other people are warned too. A report contains ONLY: the sender\'s phone number, the type of scam, how sure Linda is, a scrambled fingerprint of the message, and an anonymous device code. It NEVER contains the message text, your contacts, or your own phone number. You can turn this off any time in Settings. It is OFF until you tap Agree.
Send anonymous scam reports (never the message text) so others are warned.
This caller sent you a suspected scam message %1$d minutes ago. Do not send money.
This number was reported by other Linda users as a mobile-money scammer. Do not send money.
Linda shows a warning when a known scam number calls. It never blocks the call: you decide.
Caller warnings need Android 10 or newer.
Each button \"receives\" a message instantly, exactly like a real SMS, with no network. The last two messages must NOT warn.
Fake M-Pesa confirmation (from a normal number)
Simulate a call from the fake M-Pesa number
Call warning shown: sent you a scam message %1$d minutes ago.
No call warning (receive the fake M-Pesa message first).
Act fast. The first minutes matter most. Do these steps in order.
Some time has passed, but you can still report this and protect other people.
This only makes the steps and the report text more exact. It stays on your phone.
Number you sent the money to
M-PESA transaction code (10 letters and numbers, from YOUR payment message)
That does not look like a transaction code. Check the message that confirms your payment.
I paid from a bank account or card
Include the scam message in the report text
Linda only opens your phone app. You press send or call yourself.
Do not reply to the scammer and do not send any more money, even if they promise to return it or say you must pay a fee first.
Keep the scam message and the M-PESA message that confirms YOUR payment. Do not delete them. Take screenshots.

Forward the M-PESA message that confirms your payment to %1$s. It is free and only works within %2$d hours of the payment. Safaricom checks the request, and it may not work if the money has already been withdrawn.
Call %1$s (prepaid) or %2$s (postpaid). Say clearly that you were a victim of M-PESA fraud and ask them to block the scammer\'s number.
The %1$d-hour reversal window has passed, so money that was already withdrawn may not come back. Still call %2$s (prepaid) or %3$s (postpaid), explain what happened and ask them to block the number.
Forward the scam message to %1$s (free). Safaricom checks and blocks fraud numbers, which protects other people.
You paid from a bank account or card. Call your bank right away on the number on the back of your card, tell them it was fraud and ask them to stop or recall the payment.

Report to the police and ask for an OB (occurrence book) number. You can also call the DCI toll-free hotline %1$s. Safaricom or your bank may ask for that number. If you are in danger, call %2$s or %3$s.
For a small amount it is your choice, but reporting helps. The DCI toll-free hotline is %1$s.
Scammers often call again, pretending to be helpers who can get your money back for a fee. Nobody genuine charges you to recover money, and nobody will ever ask for your PIN.
Copy this and paste it into a message, a bank form or a police statement. It stays on your phone: Linda never sends it anywhere.
Copied. Paste it where you need it.
The numbers and steps follow Safaricom\'s published advice, but Linda cannot reverse money for you. Whether money comes back depends on Safaricom, your bank and whether it was already withdrawn.
I have been scammed. What now?
Get a step-by-step guide to try to get your money back.
Choose someone you trust. If Linda is sure you received a scam message, it sends them one short SMS so they can call and check on you.

Only your name, the kind of scam and the time, like: \"Linda alert: Mum received a suspected \'sent by mistake\' scam at 4:12 PM. Consider calling them.\" It never contains the message itself, the scammer\'s number, your contacts or your balance.
Linda sends at most one alert per scammer number every 6 hours. It uses your normal SMS balance. You can turn this off at any time.
Your name in the alert (for example Mum)
Enter the guardian\'s phone number (for example 0712345678) and your name first.
Linda needs permission to send SMS for this to work.
Guardian alerts are on, but the SMS permission was removed. No alert can be sent until you allow it again.
Test alert handed to your phone\'s SMS system. Ask your guardian whether it arrived.
The test alert could not be sent. Check the number, your SMS balance and the permission.
Let a family member know when you get a suspected scam.
When Linda is sure a message is a scam, it also says so out loud. Quiet if your phone is on silent or vibrate, or you are on a call.
On because Family Guardian is on. Turn it off here whenever you like.
